channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: Paul Martin and the team visit Aberdeenshire in Scotland, where experts Anita Manning and Adam Partridge search for antiques in the romantic setting of Crathes Castle. Paul who discovers the best item - a 19th century oriental armrest, bought in a market 20 years ago for just two pounds! Paul also takes a nostalgic look at an industry that's had an important influence on Aberdeen's historic past - shipbuilding.
